title.narrative: Response - Recovery - Resilience for Conflict-Affected Communities in Ethiopia Project

description.narrative: The development objective of Response-Recovery-Resilience for Conflict-Affected Communities in Ethiopia Project is to (i) rebuild and improve access to basic services and climate-resilient community infrastructure and (ii) improve access to multi-sectoral response services for Gender-Based Violence (GBV) survivors; in selected conflict-affected communities in Ethiopia. This project has four components. 1) The first component, Rebuilding and Improving Access to Basic Services and Climate-resilient Community Infrastructure, has the following sub-components: (i) Community-based Rapid Response Basic Services; (ii) Community-based Recovery Activities; and (iii) Strengthening Institutions for Resilience. 2) The second component, Improving Access to GBV Response Services, has the following sub-components: (i) Expanding and Strengthening GBV Services in Conflict-affected Communities; (ii) GBV Prevention and Behavior Change; and (iii) Support to Coordination, Policy Development, and Research for GBV Prevention and Response. 3) The third component, Adaptive Project Management, has the following sub-components:(i) Project Management; and (ii) Learning and Adaptive Implementation. 4) The fourth component, Contingent Emergency Response Component, is included in the project in accordance with the Investment Project Financing (IPF) Policy, paragraphs 12 and 13, for situations of urgent need of assistance and capacity constraints.

To (i) rebuild and improve access to basic services and climate-resilient community infrastructure and (ii) improve access to multi-sectoral response services for Gender-Based Violence (GBV) survivors; in selected conflict-affected communities in Ethiopia.

condition.narrative: Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section 1.A.2. The Recipient, through the FPCU and in coordination with the participating regions,shall: (i) establish no later than 90 days after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain at all times during the implementationof the Project, coordination units at the regional levels; and (ii) designate the Kebele Development Committees to serve ascoordination units at the Kebele, Woreda and community levels, respectively. The coordination units shall be responsible for, interalia, coordinating the implementation of Project activities at the regional, Kebele, Woreda and community levels, respectively, asfurther elaborated in the Project Operations Manual.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section 1.B.2. The Recipient shall, not later than thirty (30) days after the Effective Date, (andthereafter by June 15 of each subsequent EFY) prepare and furnish to the Association, a work plan and budget containing allactivities proposed for implementation in the following calendar year. The Work Plan and Budget shall ensure equitable allocationof funds to all regional states participating in the Project based on identified conflict impacts, including damages to publicinfrastructure and services as well as the hosting of Internally Displaced People.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section 2.1.The Recipient shall furnish to the Association each Project Report not later thansixty (60) days after the end of each calendar semester, covering the calendar semester.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.1. The Recipient, through the FSC, shall: (i) establish no later than 90 days afterthe Effective Date, Project steering committees at the regional levels; and (ii) designate the Woreda councils in participatingWoredas to serve as the steering committees at the Woreda levels, respectively. The Recipient shall maintain at all times duringthe implementation of the Project, said steering committees to be responsible for, inter alia, providing guidance and oversight forthe Project at the regional and Woreda levels, respectively.
